9mothers-9-mothers:ashbyhq:431e3669-d302.title: IT Support Engineer
9mothers-9-mothers:ashbyhq:431e3669-d302.description: Location: Onsite — Austin, TX Employment Type: Direct Hire, Full-Time Job Title: IT Support Engineer About 9 Mothers The modern battlefield has changed. Cheap, autonomous suicide drones have turned the tactical advantage upside down, and the world is looking for a solution. At 9 Mothers, we aren’t just "innovating"—we are building the shield. Backed by top-tier investors, we develop AI powered machines designed to intercept and neutralize Group 1/sUAS threats in real-time. Our flagship product is a low-power, counter-drone system built for the edge—on vehicles, at bases, or in a soldier's pack. Why 9 Mothers? While others build for "awareness" or "long-term research," we build for the immediate survival of those in harm’s way. We are a team of hackers, engineers, and mission-driven builders who value field-ready capability over polished slide decks. If you want to see your code or hardware in the field next month—not next year—this is your playground. Position Summary As an IT Support Engineer at 9 Mothers, you will serve as the technical backbone of our rapidly growing defense engineering team. We are looking for someone who takes full ownership of our infrastructure, identity systems, and endpoint management. You will build durable configurations, leverage aggressive AI automation, and directly safeguard our mission-critical operations and compliance standards in our Austin lab and remote field deployments. Essential Duties - IT Systems: Spend your first week getting up to speed on our infra and compliance requirements, exploring our environments, and getting hands-on with the EDDA platform. - IAM: Entra ID commercial and GCC High tenants: user accounts, groups, licensing, and provisioning. - Support & Operations: Day-to-day support for a small team of engineers — triage by business impact, communicate ETAs, and close the loop. Keep our AI agents and monitoring stack (Grafana / Loki / Prometheus) fed and honest. Keep CMMC controls compliant and aligned with the SSP. - Build: Use AI tooling aggressively — and own the verification: pilot ring before fleet-wide, read what the script touches, and keep rollbacks in hand. There is no ticketing system yet; you’ll pick and stand up the lightweight tooling you want to live in. - Grow into Field Support: Expect occasional travel to support remote deployments. Establish remote management tooling and build durable configurations that survive without you on-site. Requirements - 1–4 years in an IT administration / systems admin / DevOps / InfoSec / "desktop engineering" role. Titles don't matter; scope does. - CRITICAL (Hard Requirement): Hands-on keyboard MDM experience managing Macs. Jamf or Intune experience is a strict requirement. - You've been responsible for a fleet of Macs. You have used Apple Business Manager (ABM) for Automated Device Enrollment (ADE). You leverage Declarative Device Management (DDM) wherever possible, your MDM configs are version controlled, and your deployment workflow resembles CI (bonus points if agents run it all for you). If you use Intune's web interface, be prepared to explain why. - Comfortable in a shell. Solid networking fundamentals (VLANs, DHCP/DNS, Wi-Fi, 802.1X), with exposure to PKI being a plus. Prepare to know FIPS requirements intimately. - Calm, clear communication with frustrated people under pressure. You are an orchestrator who takes ownership, cares, and takes pride in your work. Mentally and emotionally prepared to work at a fast-paced defense startup. - Must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, or protected individual under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) — required for access to export-controlled information (ITAR/EAR). - Clear background check and pre-access screening required before any system access. Nice-to-Have - Azure GCC High Tenant or other sovereign-cloud experience. - CMMC / NIST 800-171 exposure: asset inventory, change control, and evidence discipline. - Network Admin experience: installing APs and cameras, configuring firewa

acrewcapital-vanta-com:ashbyhq:ae0fc39f-.title: Senior Fullstack Engineer, Emerging Products
acrewcapital-vanta-com:ashbyhq:ae0fc39f-.description: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. Our business has found incredible product-market fit and has monetized effectively since the day we signed our first customer. We're growing at a blistering pace, which presents career-defining opportunities for engineers to accelerate their growth and to contribute to a rapidly-scaling company. We are hiring Senior Fullstack Product Engineers (React, Typescript, Node, GraphQL & MongoDB) to build emerging products and to contribute to efforts to build features used across our Product Platform; applications through this link put you into consideration for the following teams: - Expansion: This team focuses on the full post-activation lifecycle—driving retention, expansion, and revenue automation across the product. You’ll build the core systems that power Vanta’s purchasing, trial, and renewal experiences for existing clients. This includes creating seamless checkout flows, self-serve upgrade paths, and intuitive renewal pages, as well as integrating with our evolving billing infrastructure. You’ll also develop the platform that enables “try before you buy” experiences across Vanta, giving prospects hands-on access and empowering other product teams to plug into a unified trials framework. - Activation: Responsible for rethinking the downmarket audit experience in the AI era . We leverage applied AI to automate and personalize the customer journey — reducing the time and effort it takes for customers to reach their compliance goals. Rather than optimizing for engagement alone, we focus on driving real outcomes: getting customers audit-ready, faster. Our work spans the full stack, requires deep leveraging of AI, and cuts across team and product boundaries. We're looking for engineers who are comfortable operating in a cross-functional, high-ownership environment and can drive impact beyond their immediate scope Visit our Vanta Engineering Blog https://www.vanta.com/all-categories/engineering to learn more about what our team is working on! What you’ll do as a Senior Software Engineer at Vanta: - Lead complex projects with multiple stakeholders and engineers to accelerate our roadmap and land impact faster. - Collaborate with other teams and engineers across Vanta on cross-cutting engineering initiatives or on building common product primitives. - Mentor engineers up to your own level; assigning them tasks and helping them develop their skills over the course of each project. - Make effective tradeoffs that consider business priorities, user experience, and a sustainable technical foundation. How to be successful in this role: - 5+ years of full stack experience with an emphasis on backend skills. - Experience leading small teams of engineers to deliver impactful projects. - Strong communication and collaboration skills. - Experience building user-facing SaaS products over multiple years, ideally both for startups and enterprise users. - Experience building 0→1 products as well as solving tough engineering problems- especially in environments that prioritize bias for action. - Experience with TypeScript is a plus- our stack is React, TypeScript, Node.js http://node.js, GraphQL & MongoDB. - Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact. What you can expect as a Vanta’n in Canada: - Industry-competitive salary and equity - 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage - Pension contribution - 16 weeks fully paid Parental Leave for all new parents - Health & wellness stipend - Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone

aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:871.title: LA Kings - Fan Service Coordinator
aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:871.description: Company Information For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! Job Description The Fan Experience Coordinator will be responsible for supporting the Ticket Sales and Service Department including service activation, group experiences, VIP club coordination, and event management. In addition, this individual will assist with the Fan Service Associate program. Essential Functions Assist with the seasonal Fan Service Associate program by providing clear guidance and support to Associates during event days. Work with Service team and Community Relations department to organize and delegate projects and assignments, ensuring efficient execution and a seamless fan experience. Act as the point of contact between the Kings Sales & Service team and arena game-day departments, including Guest Services and Operations. Facilitate daily communications and coordinate logistics such as event scheduling, parking, club passes and premium experiences. Support the ticket benefits program including inventory management, customer support, and in-game activation & fulfillment. Aid the Group Sales team with coordination of group leader benefits including showcasing group names on the scoreboard, arranging catering, buses, ticket package gifts, and other elements of the group sales process. Support the LA Kings in-game experiences from fulfillment to activation. This includes pre-game tours, ticket pack redemptions, Zamboni rides, Tunnel Team, and post-game events. Provide day-to-day administrative support to the Ticket Sales and Service department including ordering supplies, organization of STM collateral, support of STM mailings, game day materials etc. Assist with the Season Ticket Member and client gifting processes; assist in brainstorming gift ideas, organize and maintain gift/recipient lists, and execute fulfillment of gifting distribution and/or gifting events. Process VIP and department ticket requests as needed; i.e. coordination of club passes, parking arrangement, etc. Support the planning of VIP Season Ticket Member away trips in collaboration with relevant departments. Engage with guests to ensure a best-in-class service experience for Season Ticket Members and their guests. Specific Job Knowledge, Skill and Ability The Fan Service Coordinator must possess the following knowledge, skills and abilities and be able to explain and demonstrate that he or she can perform the essential functions of the job, with or without reasonable accommodation, using some other combination of skill and abilities: Passionate about customer service and uphold a strong work ethic Assertive, persistent and results oriented with the ability to multitask Strong organizational skills; attention to detail Possess strong written and communication skills and an excellent phone presence Knowledge of computer programs such as Microsoft Word and Outlook. Ability to learn required business systems Must be available to work weekends, nights and holidays Qualification Standards Education: High Schoo

beedie-beedie:lever:09aedb2a-920e-4d1f-a.title: Cloud and Security Administrator
beedie-beedie:lever:09aedb2a-920e-4d1f-a.description: At Beedie, we foster talent, encourage innovation, and reward success. We’re always looking for like-minded people to join our team and share our passion for doing the best work of our lives. Our approach is simple: we work hard, we have fun, and we make a difference. And, we’ve been recognized as a top employer provincially and nationally. Our people are the heart and soul of our organization. If you are passionate, hardworking, ambitious, and want to be part of a dynamic and growing company that will take your career forward, join us. We are seeking an experienced Cloud and Security Administrator to own the administration, security, and continuous improvement of our Microsoft cloud environment. This role is responsible for maintaining a secure, reliable, and high-performing infrastructure across Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, and enterprise networking while driving security best practices throughout the organization. Working closely with internal IT staff and external vendors, you will proactively manage cloud infrastructure, strengthen our cybersecurity posture, automate operational processes, and provide Tier 3 technical support for approximately 400 employees across multiple office locations and construction sites.
responsibilities: Cloud Administration
Administer and maintain Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 environments.
Deploy, configure, and manage Azure resources including Virtual Machines, Virtual Networks, Storage Accounts, Firewalls, Load Balancers, and networking components.
Administer Microsoft Entra ID including users, groups, licensing, authentication, naming standards, and identity governance.
Manage Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive for Business, and related Microsoft 365 services.
Configure and maintain enterprise cloud integrations including Single Sign-On (SSO), Conditional Access, and identity federation.
Monitor Microsoft service health and resolve infrastructure and cloud service incidents.
Ensure Azure and Microsoft 365 environments remain organized, secure, and aligned with established standards.
Security
Lead ongoing improvements to the organization's Microsoft cloud security posture.
Develop, implement, and maintain cloud security standards, baselines, and best practices.
Ensure cloud services comply with organizational security policies and regulatory requirements.
Administer Conditional Access policies, security controls, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Purview, and Data Loss Prevention policies.
Coordinate incident response activities with external MDR/XDR partners.
Conduct security reviews, risk assessments, and vulnerability remediation.
Participate in internal and external security audits.
Perform security hardening across cloud infrastructure and Microsoft 365 services.
Monitor security alerts, investigate threats, and coordinate remediation activities.
Ensure firewalls and security appliances remain current with firmware updates and security patches.
Infrastructure & Operations
Administer cloud backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions.
Monitor system performance, capacity, and availability to ensure optimal operation.
Develop PowerShell and Azure CLI automation to improve operational efficiency.
Working knowledge of enterprise networking including firewalls, switching, routing, VPNs, and wireless infrastructure.
Maintain accurate technical documentation, procedures, standards, and diagrams.
Coordinate with technology vendors to resolve complex technical issues.
Participate in change management processes to ensure infrastructure changes are implemented safely and consistently.
Support
Provide Tier 3 technical support for Windows 11 laptops, mobile devices, Microsoft 365 services, and cloud infrastructure.
Act as the escalation point for complex infrastructure and cloud-related issues.
Collaborate with the other IT team members to resolve technical issues.
Support infrastructure and technology deployments across all office locations and construction sites.
Reporting
Prepare monthly operational and security reports summarizing infrastructure health, security posture, incidents, vulnerabilities, project progress, and key performance metrics.
Provide recommendations for continuous improvement, risk reduction, and technology modernization.
qualifications: Required:
College diploma or university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
Minimum 5 years of progressive systems administration experience, including at least 2 years independently administering enterprise Microsoft cloud infrastructure and security platforms.
Advanced administration experience with Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Azure, Microsoft Defender and Exchange Online.
Demonstrated experience implementing Conditional Access, MFA, device compliance, identity governance and endpoint security policies.
Strong PowerShell scripting and automation experience, including Microsoft Graph.
Experience leading or serving as the technical lead on Microsoft cloud infrastructure projects.
Experience monitoring, investigating and responding to security incidents and vulnerabilities.
Strong troubleshooting skills across cloud services, identity, networking and endpoint management.
Experience supporting a mid-sized enterprise environment (approximately 300+ users).
Strong written and verbal communication skills with excellent customer service and interpersonal abilities.
Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team.
Demonstrated attention to detail with strong organizational and prioritization skills.
Ability to adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment.
Valid BC Driver's Licence
Primarily office-based with occasional after-hours or weekend work to support maintenance windows and critical incidents.

careerstrengo-careerstrengo:ashbyhq:8a2b.title: Graduate AI & Digital Success Specialist - Dutch speaking
careerstrengo-careerstrengo:ashbyhq:8a2b.description: Welcome to the forefront of AI-driven communication. At Trengo, we’re redefining the industry by replacing repetitive work with meaningful conversations through our AI-powered customer engagement platform. We unify communication channels and leverage agentic AI to deliver proactive, human-like service for thousands of businesses worldwide. As a fast-moving Dutch scale-up backed by a $36M Series A, we thrive on acceleration. We are looking for a pioneer to help us bridge the gap between human connection and digital efficiency. THE ROLE: DIGITAL-FIRST SUCCESS This is a newly created, hybrid role for someone who sits at the intersection of relationship management, data-driven marketing, and tech enthusiasm. You aren't just managing accounts; you can help co-create a proactive, tech-first customer journey. Your mission is to move away from traditional, constant 1:1 meetings toward scalable, tech-driven engagement. You will use data triggers and AI activation strategies to ensure our customers stay healthy and engaged at scale. WHAT YOUR DAY LOOKS LIKE - Scalable Activation: You’ll help design and execute outreach programs, in-app notifications, and webinars to drive deep product activation across your portfolio. - AI Champion: Your primary objective will be finding scalable ways to help customers implement and see the value of Trengo’s AI-driven features. - Data-Driven Strategy: You’ll use data triggers and CRM automations to identify which customers need a nudge and which are ready for expansion. - Proactive Engagement: While you focus on digital-first success, you are a strong proactive communicator who is ready to jump into meetings with customers when a personal touch is needed to drive growth. - Portfolio Management: You will take ownership of a segment of our business, allowing the team to focus on high-touch accounts while you master the art of a wider "one-to-many" success. WE’D LOVE TO MEET YOU IF YOU: - Experience: You have approximately one year of professional experience and are ready to continue growing your career in a fast-paced SaaS environment. - Tech & Data Savvy: You have a high degree of technical affinity. You are comfortable with automations and enjoy exploring how AI can optimize workflows. - Languages: You have business proficiency in both Dutch and English. You feel confident supporting our core Dutch market and collaborating internally in both languages. - Communication Style: You can translate complex technical topics into clear, actionable advice. You love talking to people but are also on top of activating customers through scalable channels like webinars or video content. - "Hacker" Mindset: You are a self-starter who is always looking for a more efficient, automated way to solve a manual problem. ⚙️ OUR TECH & AI MINDSET AI is not a buzzword at Trengo — it's part of how we build and operate. You'll work with AI-driven features, automation, data, or tools that help us move faster and smarter. We value thoughtful use of AI that creates real value for customers and teams. WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU? This is what we carefully prepared for you: - 🚀 A key role where you’ll make a visible impact in a vibrant scale-up environment. - 🌍 Hybrid working + 2 months per year to work abroad. - 🏗️ A strong onboarding program with hands-on training and a dedicated buddy to set you up for success. - 🧘 Mental health support with free sessions from on-demand psychologists (OpenUp) https://openup.com/nl/. - 📚 Learning budget + 2 extra days off to attend courses or conferences. - 🌴 28 vacation days to rest, recharge, and travel - 🚆 Travel reimbursement to our Utrecht HQ. - 📶 Monthly internet & phone allowance to stay connected. - 🗣️ Dutch courses for our international colleagues. - 🍴 Daily warm lunches prepared by our workplace experience team when you’re at our beautiful Utrecht office https://www.centralpark-utrecht.nl/en. - 💼 Pension contribution to help you plan for the future. - 🛫 Sabbatical: After two years, enjoy up to t

claspgroup-clasp-group:ashbyhq:dcd10131-.title: Product Manager — Candidate & Recruiter Platform
claspgroup-clasp-group:ashbyhq:dcd10131-.description: PRODUCT MANAGER — CANDIDATE & RECRUITER PLATFORM Remote (ET & CT time zones only – some travel required) About Us Clasp is a venture-backed, mission-driven startup transforming access to education and career pathways. We are revolutionizing the way employers attract and retain critical talent and the way colleges and universities support their students through education financing — all while tackling the student debt crisis. (Yep, we think BIG.) We like to think of ourselves as more than a fintech; we're a catalyst for economic mobility. A Forbes Fintech 50 company, portfolio company of SHRM (Society of Human Resource Management — the largest HR organization out there!) and recipient of "Startup of the Year" by StartUp Boston, Clasp is driven by our commitment to social impact and innovation. Our work spans two business lines: Clasp Talent helps healthcare employers attract and retain critical talent by connecting them with diverse candidates and using student loan repayment as a powerful recruiting and retention tool. We meaningfully connect employers, educational institutions, and learners to drive mutual benefit. Clasp Finance equips colleges and universities with lending technology to launch and operate their own private student loan programs, enabling schools to step in and support their students directly with financial aid. Join us on our journey to give power to learners and unlock fulfilling careers that drive positive change in their communities and beyond. What We Need Clasp is looking for a Product Manager to own the candidate and recruiter experience within Clasp Talent — the end-to-end product that helps healthcare students find jobs with student loan repayment and gives employers the platform they trust to build long-term clinical pipelines. You will own a two-sided product. On the candidate side, you will drive activation, conversion, and retention across the applicant journey — from a candidate's first discovery of Clasp through onboarding, application, and offer signing. On the employer side, you will own the platform that healthcare employers rely on every day to source candidates, move them through pipelines, and build the talent pipelines that solve their hardest staffing challenges. Both sides are critical. Candidates are the users whose experience defines the product; employers are the customers whose trust drives the business. The Product Manager in this role will care deeply about funnel mechanics and activation while building the platform depth that makes employer teams' daily work better. You will report to the Director of Product, who oversees product across Clasp Talent and Clasp Finance. You will partner closely with leaders in marketing, partner success, design, and engineering, as well as your product teammate who owns the experience that begins after a candidate signs an offer. What You'll Do - Own the Candidate Funnel: Drive activation, conversion, and retention across the entire applicant journey — discovery, account creation, profile completion, application, interview, and offer signing. Set funnel metrics, instrument what matters, and run the experiments that move the needle. - Own the Employer Platform: Own the platform experience that healthcare employers use to source, screen, and place candidates. Recruiters log in every day and their workflow efficiency directly impacts our business. - Build the Network Effect: Identify and ship the features that make each new student more likely to fulfill a commitment to an open role and each new employer more valuable to students. - Deeply Understand Your Users: Spend real time with healthcare students and the recruiters who hire them. Learn what students actually want from their careers and what they fear about the job search. Watch recruiters work and understand the pressures they're under to fill critical roles. Build from what you hear, not from what you assume. - Partner with Marketing: Work closely with student marketing on top-of-funnel perfor

cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:68.title: Safety Advisor
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:68.description: Home Comfort & Safety Advisor Position Summary The Home Comfort & Safety Advisor is responsible for building long-term relationships with homeowners by serving as a trusted advisor for their plumbing, heating, and electrical needs. This role focuses on understanding each customer's home, lifestyle, and priorities to recommend customized solutions that improve safety, efficiency, comfort, and the overall appearance of the home. The Advisor conducts annual (or more frequent) in-home visits, evaluates plumbing and electrical systems, identifies opportunities for repairs or upgrades, and collaborates with service and installation teams to deliver an exceptional customer experience. While this position includes sales goals and revenue expectations, success is equally measured by customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term relationship building. Key Responsibilities Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with homeowners. Conduct on-site inspections of residential plumbing and electrical systems. Assess system performance and identify opportunities to improve safety, efficiency, and reliability. Prepare and present repair and improvement proposals based on customer needs. Answer customer questions regarding estimates, repair recommendations, and available options. Educate homeowners on recommended solutions and preventative maintenance opportunities. Coordinate with service technicians and installation teams to ensure a seamless customer experience. Maintain accurate records of inspections, recommendations, estimates, and customer interactions. Meet established sales, conversion, and customer satisfaction goals while maintaining a consultative, customer-first approach. Required Qualifications Apprentice Plumbing License or Apprentice Electrical License. Valid driver's license with a clean driving record. Ability to pass a background check. Authorization to work in the United States. Preferred Qualifications Journeyman or Master Plumbing License. Journeyman or Master Electrical License. Experience in residential plumbing, electrical, HVAC, or home services. Strong consultative sales and customer service skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Experience preparing estimates and explaining repair recommendations to customers. Strong organizational, time management, and problem-solving abilities. Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and customer management software. Ability to explain technical information in a clear, customer-friendly manner. Physical Requirements Ability to perform residential home inspections, including walking, climbing stairs, bending, kneeling, and lifting up to 50 pounds. Ability to work both indoors and outdoors in varying weather conditions. Ability to safely operate a company vehicle and travel to customer locations. What Success Looks Like Develops trusted relationships with homeowners. Consistently delivers outstanding customer service. Achieves sales and conversion goals through education and consultative recommendations. Maintains high customer satisfaction and retention. Collaborates effectively with service and installation teams to ensure exceptional customer experiences.

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:a5a33c5c-1e4.title: Italian Accessibility Tester
weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:a5a33c5c-1e4.description: About Welocalize Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale. About the Role Welocalize is expanding its network of accessibility testers to validate the language-specific accessibility of localized digital content: web pages, applications, and documents. You will serve as a native-language expert reviewer, confirming that accessibility elements not only survive translation but are accurate, understandable, and functional in Italian. This role requires fluency in the target language, hands-on experience with assistive technology in that language, and familiarity with Digital Accessibility standards and guidelines such as PDF/UA, WCAG 2.1 & 2.2, and EN 301 549 to complement accessibility testing done internally. Work is assigned on a project basis. You will receive a defined scope, a testing checklist, and access credentials. Findings are reported in a structured defect log and specific bug tracking system. What You Will Do The actual scope will vary by assignment, but the general extent of this role is outlined below. Language Validation: Confirm correct language codes in HTML and PDF metadata, and identify mixed-language content missing proper declarations. In-Language Screen Reader Testing: Using native-language screen readers (JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver, TalkBack, or Narrator), review translated accessible text — including hidden elements, tooltips, error messages, alt text, and UI labels — for accuracy, natural phrasing, and clarity when read aloud. Multimedia Accessibility Review: Evaluate captions, transcripts, and audio descriptions for accuracy, synchronization, and natural language, and confirm multimedia controls are properly labeled in the target language. Defect Reporting: Log findings with WCAG/PDF-UA references, supporting screenshots or recordings, and severity classifications; participate in review calls with the QA Lead as needed. What We Are Looking For Required Native or near-native fluency in Italian; you are the authoritative voice on whether translated content reads naturally and is understandable. Demonstrated hands-on experience testing digital content with assistive technology/AT. Working knowledge of WCAG 2.1 & 2.2 AA and EN 301 549. Ability to evaluate content from a native-speaker accessibility perspective — not just technical compliance, but real-world usability for screen reader users who speak the language. Reliable access to relevant devices and operating systems to replicate real-world usage in the target locale. Nice to have Strong written communication skills in English for defect reporting and general communications. Experience with PDF accessibility testing using PAC 3 or Adobe Acrobat Pro Accessibility Checker. Familiarity with internationalization, localization, and translation workflows; understanding of how accessibility elements can be affected during format conversion. Personal use of assistive technology. Tools and Environment Welocalize provides access credentials and a structured test plan per engagement. Testers are expected to supply their own device and assistive technology setup appropriate to the target locale. Commonly used tools in this role include: Screen readers: JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver (macOS/iOS), TalkBack (Android), Narrator (Windows) Browser/screen reader pairings aligned to the target locale's most common usage patterns Caption and transcript review: native video players, .srt/.vtt file review PDF accessibility: PAC 3, Adobe Acrobat Pro (provided where required) Defect logging: Jira bug tracking system is most frequently used What to Expect Assignments are project-based with clear scope documents, test checklists, and agreed turnaround timelines provided before work beg
